name: Harmony 650, the four activities
description: What each of the 650's activities sends when it starts, and what Off sends. No expectations yet: this records the reference for later runs.

steps.instruction: On the Harmony 650, start TV kijken and wait until the remote is done
Start Kodi kijken and wait until the remote is done
Start LG kijken and wait until the remote is done
Start LG WebOS and wait until the remote is done
Press Off and wait until the remote is done
